notes.title: Update and game improvements
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thanks to all your feedback, we've rolled out an update packed with improvements!

What’s New
Daily Tasks: Complete daily tasks to earn additional tournament tickets!
Enhanced Offline Gains: Now, you can collect up to 3 tickets while offline.
Improved Ranking Rewards: We've adjusted drop rates for higher ranks, so you can earn even better gear as you climb the ranks.
Expanded Campaign Levels: New levels have been added to make item farming more rewarding.
Extra Information Buttons: We’ve added helpful buttons to explain some key game mechanics.
Stay tuned for more updates! If you have suggestions or want to score some extra community loot, join us on our Discord server.

Enjoy the game!
